name: Tenant deletion at scale, realistic SaaS schema, real S3 (Basin vs Postgres)
claim: Real production tables have 5-20 indexes and 1-3 FK constraints. PG's DROP SCHEMA CASCADE walks every row × every index + validates every FK on the cascade; Basin's tenant teardown stays O(file_count). The crossover from the simple card moves dramatically left under this schema profile.

primary.label: Basin/Postgres ratio at 5000 files (realistic schema, real S3)
